Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-01
DOoc-0023 2026-03-15
SHIFT NOTES — Early Controls Intake Before the Desk
Rotation
Date: 2026-03-15
Station: DEMO-STATION-01
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
05:55 — Early-shift note from PERSON-0025 for TEAM-0001.
Prepare the controls intake desk before the coordinator
rotation at 08:25. ISSUE-0121 and TASK-0323 are locating
references for the example folder used during the handover
briefing.
06:30 — Use two-touch intake for a new submission. The first
clerk writes the sender's question on a cream intake card
beside the supplied reference. The receiving coordinator
checks the destination and expected reply date at the next
touch. Keep the sender's own question separate from the desk's
proposed next action.
07:10 — Ask the triage lead to record the initial priority and
its written reason on the intake sheet. Leave space for the
owning team and for any later person assignment. Do not use
the coordinator rotation as a reason to skip the rationale or
to infer ownership from whoever is nearby.
08:05 — Before intake pauses for rotation, move unfinished
intake conversations to the carry clipboard. Each needs a
receiving role and a contact time. The incoming clerk should
be able to resume the question without reconstructing the
sender's intent from a short title.
Next-shift list
_ Check the cream cards for a destination and expected reply
date.
_ Confirm that the priority reason is readable.
D. Worker 0025
Demo Worker 0025, Demo Team 01
